item.title: Gachagua, Kalonzo Team to Sue 2 MPs, 12 Cops
item.description: The opposition will no longer engage with the Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja due to his reluctance to take action against the individuals.

item.title: 'Somebody is Giving Teargas to the Wrong People' - Murkomen Says After Rally Chaos
item.description: Speaking during a security briefing in Laikipia on Thursday, Murkomen stated that "I can tell you for sure it is not police officers using those teargas."

item.title: CS Murkomen Issues Directives Following the Death of Teacher
item.description: Murkomen said that the Inspector General will spearhead investigations to lift the lid on what exactly happened and nab every individual who was involved.

item.title: Charles Kanjama Elected New LSK President
item.description: He was elected in an election held on Thursday and is expected to lead the LSK over the next two years, which includes the 2027 campaigns and elections.

item.title: NPS Clarifies ‘Shoot to Kill’ Order on Protesting Githurai Residents
item.description: In its clarification, the police service urged Kenyans to rely on verified communication from official NPS social media accounts and credible news outlets.

item.title: Ministry of Health Clarifies Pricing for New Long-Acting HIV Drug
item.description: The government clarifies the cost of the new HIV/AIDS injectable drugs, with the initial cost stated by the Ministry of Health sparking confusion.

item.title: Trump Takes Action on RSF in Sudan Weeks After Ruto Request
item.description: The U.S. action on RSF follows similar decisions made by the United Kingdom and the European Union late last year and earlier this year aimed at stopping the war.

item.title: Babu Owino’s Brother-in-Law Reportedly Missing After Arrest by DCI
item.description: Babu Owino's brother-in-law is said to have been taken by six DCI officers on Tuesday, and was beinbg transported to Nairobi, but no one has heard from him since.

item.title: Concerts, Public Events Among Events Targetted in Latest Changes
item.description: Part of the changes are to ensure the safety of levellers and guard from chaos that has resulted in demises in some of the public concerts.

item.title: U.S. Govt Issues Travel Advisory to All Travellers Ahead of 2026 FIFA World Cup
item.description: The 2026 World Cup has been projected to be the largest in FIFA tournament history, featuring 48 teams with nearly 7 million foreigners expected to attend.
